हवन

HAVANA . One of the eleven Rudras. (Anuśāsana Parva, Chapter 150, Verse 13).

हविघ्न

HAVIGHNA . A King of ancient days, who was one of those who were to be remembered both in the morning and the evening. (anuśāsana parva, Chapter 155, Verse 58).

हविर्भू

HAVIRBHŪ . Wife of pulastya. (See pulastya).

हविर्धामन्

HAVIRDHĀMAN . Son of Antardhāman of the manu dynasty. (anuśāsana parva, Chapter 147, Verse 24).

हविर्धान

HAVIRDHĀNA . A grandson of emperor pṛthu, who had two sons called antardhāna and Vādi and to antardhāna was born a son called havirdhāna by śikhaṇḍinī, and they had six sons called prācīnabarhis, śukra, gaya, kṛṣṇa, vraja and ajina. (viṣṇu purāṇa, Part 1, Chapter 14).

हविष्मान्

HAVIṢMĀN . A great sage who was a member of the assembly of indra. (Sabhā Parva, Chapter 7, Verse 13).

हविष्मती

HAVIṢMATĪ . A daughter of aṅgiras. (Vana Parva, Chapter 218, Verse 6).

हविश्रवस्

HAVIŚRAVAS . A King born in the family of kuru, a King of the lunar dynasty. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 94, Verse 59).

हव्यघ्न

HAVYA¤GHNA . A rākṣasa about whom the following story is told in the brahmāṇḍa purāṇa.

havyaghna was born from the smoke which rose from the fire of a yajña which sage bharadvāja along with his wife Paiṭhīnasī conducted on the banks of river gautamī, and he began eating the havis. Questioned about it by bharadvāja havyaghna answered as follows:--“I am an unfortunate fellow called kṛṣṇa cursed by brahmā. If you would kindly sprinkle on me the gaṅgā water, suvarṇa, ghee and soma I will be redeemed from the curse.

bharadvāja complied with the request of havyaghna and he got redemption from the curse.
